name: Microbiome
failures: Dysbiosis after antibiotics, loss of diversity, C. difficile overgrowth. Not human cells at all.

see.note: Metagenomic sequencing of stool is cheap and comprehensive.

model.note: Nobody can specify a healthy microbiome; it varies enormously between healthy people.

reach.note: Oral and rectal routes reach it directly.

edit.note: Faecal transplant products approved 2022–23 for recurrent C. difficile. Crude but effective.

verify.note: Engraftment measurable by sequencing; clinical endpoints clear for C. diff.
